ITEM 1 | Dark red-purple whole olives, glossy and smooth-skinned, scattered across the bowl in about 15 pieces, each roughly 1.5-2 cm long, some halved or whole with pits intact | 110
ITEM 2 | Pale green cucumber slices, thin rounds and half-moons about 0.3-0.5 cm thick and 2-3 cm across, moist and translucent-edged, with visible seeds, scattered over the greens | 90
ITEM 3 | Shaved hard cheese in thin irregular flakes and shards, pale ivory to golden-tan, dry and slightly crystalline, piled in the center and across the top, about 1-3 cm wide and 0.1-0.2 cm thick | 40
ITEM 4 | Mixed fresh salad leaves, bright to dark green with some ruffled edges, spread as a loose layer under and between other ingredients, mostly flat with a few folded leaves at the top rim | 45
ITEM 5 | Golden-brown toasted bread cubes, about 1.5-2 cm square, crisp and slightly dry with darker browned edges, a few pieces scattered near the center and lower left | 15
